planner.label: planner
planner.guidance: Decompose objectives, resolve ambiguity, sequence dependent tasks, and define verification criteria.

scout.label: scout
scout.guidance: Explore the codebase and documentation read-only to gather grounded file and line evidence.

researcher.label: researcher
researcher.guidance: Search external documentation, release notes, benchmarks, and prior art on the web with grounded URL citations.

debugger.label: debugger
debugger.guidance: Reproduce failures, isolate root-cause invariants, and explain causal chains before proposing fixes.

builder.label: builder
builder.guidance: Implement or refactor bounded code changes while preserving module invariants and passing focused checks.

ui-designer.label: ui-designer
ui-designer.guidance: Build or refine user interface layouts, visual hierarchy, responsiveness, and accessibility.

sweeper.label: sweeper
sweeper.guidance: Apply a decided, repeatable transformation across bounded files with automated checks.

reviewer.label: reviewer
reviewer.guidance: Adversarially challenge diffs and plans against requirements to uncover defects and unchecked assumptions.

verifier.label: verifier
verifier.guidance: Write or run focused checks, exercise edge cases and invariants, and report pass/fail evidence.
